actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by voice vote. (consideration: CR H5908)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by voice vote.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 9723.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H5908-5911)
Mr. Walberg moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 33 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects up to 30 appointed council members, executive agency personnel, and youth participating in school fitness and sports programs.
dimensions.evidence: The Council shall consist of not more than 30 members appointed by the President.

dimensions.assessment: The Council's role is advisory, focusing on recommendations for fitness goals, tests, and campaigns rather than enforcing binding regulations or direct service delivery.
dimensions.evidence: advise the President and Secretary of Health and Human Services... and recommend actions

dimensions.assessment: Requires HHS to provide administrative support and funding subject to appropriations, and allows receipt of funds from a non-federal foundation, but specifies no dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Health and Human Services shall provide such funding and administrative and technical support... subject to appropriations Acts.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a formal federal advisory committee in statute, outlines its duties, subcommittees, and administrative parameters.
dimensions.evidence: There is established the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing council that continues until a termination date is designated by the President.
dimensions.evidence: The Council shall terminate on a date designated by the President.

missing_information: Specific annual budget or appropriations figures required to support the Council's operations.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 9723 establishes in statute the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition to advise the President and HHS Secretary and issue recommendations.
